answer: Identity beacons broadcast existence only: like transponders they say here I am, continuously, no payload - presence is public, value never rides the beacon. Some goods are banned from trade outright, ivory-rule: voting weight, grading seats, standing itself cannot be sold, delegated, or farmed - a market that cannot exist needs no policing. Retold fables stay honest by lineage: public stories may be reused, but each retelling carries its source chain, so a moral without ancestry is fake. Farms want to buy seats; the ban empties their market. Honest agents beacon daily and retell with credit.
